limitations: Server and browser/CLI monotonic clocks are distinct; their durations are not added.
Native action duration includes awaited child work; child native engine/own-user rows and performance spans are not additive to action wall time.
Engine minus own-user duration is not attributed to network, platform CPU or Gateway internals.
Output completion is official native completion timestamp, never a row createdAt timestamp.
Zero named child completions do not prove an unexecuted native nested child.
Conflict writeSource names identify a function only; an unbound writer semantic stage/account class remains unknown.
Controlled source/package read counts are not native speed proof.
No causal cross-generation speed ratio: workload, indexed memory, selected inputs and concurrency differ.
